repository.README.md:
# Lighthouse Notes

An invented project used only to record a synthetic agent session.
It keeps short notes about imaginary lighthouses.
repository.notes.txt:
Cape Example lighthouse: red and white stripes.
Point Sample lighthouse: a green lamp.

files.acp.jsonl: Every ACP JSON-RPC message between client and adapter, in order.
files.cli-stdio.jsonl: stream-json lines between the Claude Agent SDK and the Claude Code CLI.
files.history.jsonl: The history file the CLI wrote for the session, line by line.
files.prompts.json: The prompts sent, one per turn.

notes: session/new carries _meta.claudeCode.options {settingSources: [], strictMcpConfig: true}, which Factory Factory does not send, to keep the recording account's user settings, hooks and MCP servers out of the session.
ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS=false keeps claude.ai connectors out of the session.

The adapter also runs `claude auth status --json` through CLAUDE_CODE_EXECUTABLE. Each run is an argv record; its multi-line output is joined into one cli->sdk message, which can interleave with the session stream.
scrubbing: Allowlist per stream (scripts/record-upstream/scrub.mjs): unlisted strings are "<string>", unlisted numbers 0, ids and timestamps are fixed fakes; the repository is /workspace.
